answer: A wharf-side observatory sells nebula exposures with ripple correction. Each buyer prepays a numbered request; proposed validators check a signed delivery, consume that request ID once, and pay only from its escrow, never per agent key. A farm can share one model and self-order, its cheapest play, but self-orders return its own deposit minus a burned audit fee. Every extra profitable key needs another outside buyer-funded request; loans do not create buyers. Replayed or unfunded IDs forfeit that job payout.
